feature_contract.goal: Recover fresh binocular DirectGPU projection and newest-frame selection after an OutRun game process restart while preserving same-run duplicate filtering, R32 GPU fence ownership, and fallback menus.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only host R23 per-run producer frame-selection cursor, helper and native C++ smoke; no game/FFB/HUD/multiview or backend changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Source-backed candidate restart stall: the host lastProcessedStereoFrame spans game runs but the reader swaps runGeneration/PID; a new game frameId starts low, making R37FrameIdBefore(old,new) reject eligible frames. Native negative test first confirms no candidate until cursor is rebound; no HMD runtime incident is claimed.
trace_stages: Original game Frame.v2 Present publishes frameId and runGeneration/PID; RenderFrameReader filters obsolete identities.
R23 OpenXR host DirectGPU history selection compares lastProcessedStereoFrame and newest eligible ring slots before R32 EVENT-ACK.
Verified fresh stereo frame is staged to per-eye D3D11 host projection with normal OpenXR xrEndFrame and fallback preserved.
subcomponents: Bind host last-displayed stereo frame cursor to runGeneration/PID; clear previous run's cached projection and bundle only when the identity changes.
Preserve same-run ordering and invalid run publications; regression tests cover a game restart with low frameIds, same-run duplicate filter, malformed identity, and changed PID.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: After game PID/run generation changes, R23 selects newly restarted game frame 1/2 instead of rejecting it behind stale last-displayed frame 9000.
Same-run repeated frame IDs remain rejected; invalid identity does not clear the cursor and legacy non-direct/menu projection and GPU ACK retain their existing route.
Native C++ smoke on x64 OpenXR host, full Win32/game/package DX9Ex Active plus Domain Isolation and source impact succeed on the exact material/validation SHA.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The R23 RenderFrameReader is run-identity aware, but lastProcessedStereoFrame remains a host-loop uint32_t across game process restarts.
source_trace: Verified projection→R32 async EVENT/ACK→OpenXR stereo views
diagnosis.root_cause: Host last-displayed frame identifier had no run-epoch binding; a restarted game's lower frameIds could fail the monotonic comparison against the previous process.
alternatives_rejected: Do not disable last-frame duplicate checks globally: same-run stale frames would be re-presented.
Do not read old shared ring frames through classic fallback: current reader already guards stale producer identity.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: R23 now observes the validated history's runGeneration/PID and invalidates only stale host cursor/projection on a changed epoch.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Extended direct_ring_latest_smoke.cpp to assert old 9000 vs restarted frames 1/2 fails before epoch switch, then selects newest after new run while same-run duplicates stay blocked.

runtime_gate: RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED; no Quest3/VDXR restart, stereo, FPS or gameplay test occurred.
next_action: Rerun full DX9Ex policy/host/game/package and Domain/full-source impact on new exact SHA. If compiler or source-impact gate fails, repair under same task, not a new score. Quest3/VDXR remains untested.
